images.author: Hugo Sykes
images.why: Caption identifies a white rhinoceros grazing in Kenyan grassland; species tags include Ceratotherium simum, adult and male. Promising habitat match; dimensions and visual quality unverified.

images.author: Zhang Thomas
images.why: 4240 × 2832 photograph explicitly identifying a white rhinoceros in South African savanna. Dry grassland matches the brief; sharpness and 9:10 crop need visual review.

images.author: Rafael Peier
images.why: Caption identifies a walking white rhinoceros in Namibia's open landscape; Canon EOS M5 camera metadata supports photographic provenance. Native dimensions and crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Rafael Peier
images.why: Source explicitly identifies a standing white rhinoceros in dry Namibian grassland. An alternative standing pose from a documented camera photograph; dimensions and visual quality unverified.

images.author: Ted McDonnell
images.why: Caption specifically identifies a southern white rhinoceros grazing in natural habitat. Species match is explicit; precise location, dimensions and full-body framing remain unverified.

images.author: redcharlie
images.why: Photographer's description identifies a white rhino in a South African nature reserve; Canon EOS R5 photograph. Dry-grass habitat fits; horn condition, dimensions and crop require visual review.

images.author: Brian Miller
images.why: 2559 × 1706 original; official caption confirms southern white rhinoceros in Hluhluwe-iMfolozi Park. Rights discrepancy: page states Public Domain, but filename mentions Creative Commons ND; clarify before cropping.

images.author: karatara
images.why: 2465 × 1643; caption explicitly identifies Ceratotherium simum walking in South African savanna. Closer-view fallback, with less assurance of retaining the whole animal in a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Dipinder Rainu
images.why: Caption places a one-horned rhino in Kaziranga grassland; species tags explicitly include Rhinoceros unicornis. Strong location and habitat match; dimensions and visual quality unverified.

images.author: Banhisikha Banerjee
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies an Indian rhinoceros in lush grassland with birds on its back, photographed in India. Attractive habitat context; exact park, dimensions and crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Nitesh Mehera
images.why: 3990 × 5997 portrait photograph; caption confirms Indian rhinoceroses grazing in Kaziranga. Useful vertical starting point, although misty light and multiple animals differ from the ideal single-animal card.

images.author: Max Turek
images.why: 3024 × 4032 portrait photograph; caption confirms a greater one-horned rhinoceros in Chitwan grassland. Suitable portrait proportions; described as a close-up, so full-body coverage needs review.

images.author: Prayag Bhowmik
images.why: Caption identifies an Indian rhinoceros grazing in lush Indian jungle habitat; tags confirm Rhinoceros unicornis. Green environmental alternative; dimensions and unobstructed body visibility unverified.

images.author: Daiwik Shah
images.why: 4000 × 6000 portrait photograph from Sonepur, Nepal; source identifies the one-horned species and tags Rhinoceros unicornis. High-resolution close-up fallback; full-body framing unverified.

images.author: Bhargav Keot
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies Rhinoceros unicornis at Kaziranga's Bagori safari area. Resting-in-grass alternative; does not provide the preferred standing pose. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Prajwal Bajracharya
images.why: Source locates the grazing rhino in Narayani, Nepal, and explicitly tags Indian rhinoceros and Rhinoceros unicornis. Lush-green close-up fallback; dimensions and full-body coverage unverified.
